metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana lower in November 2024 than any other November from 2012 to 2023, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use NOAA VIIRS data (FIRMS - Fire Information for Resource Management System) - VIIRS has fire detection data available through GEE - Need to compare November 2024 active fire counts vs. all November months from 2012-2023 - Focus on Punjab and Haryana region (Northern India) 2. **Masking strategy**: - VIIRS fire data doesn't require cloud masking for fire detection - Will count detected fire pixels/hotspots - Filter by confidence level if available 3. **Logic**: - Extract fire counts for each November (2012-2023 and 2024) - Compare November 2024 count with all historical Novembers - If Nov 2024 is LOWER than ANY other November, answer is A (Yes) - If Nov 2024 is higher than or equal to some Novembers, answer is B (No) - Handle cases where data is missing or invalid ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate bounding box) punjab_haryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.0, 78.5, 32.5]) # VIIRS Fire data collection viirs_fires = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') print("Analyzing VIIRS fire counts for November (2012-2023 vs 2024)...") print("Region: Punjab & Haryana") print() # Collect fire counts for each November fire_counts = {} # Historical Novembers (2012-2023) for year in range(2012, 2024): start_date = f'{year}-11-01' end_date = f'{year}-11-30' col = viirs_fires.filterBounds(punjab_haryana).filterDate(start_date, end_date) count = col.size().getInfo() if count > 0: # Sum confidence detections fire_counts[year] = count print(f"Nov {year}: {count} fire detections") else: print(f"Nov {year}: 0 detections") # November 2024 start_2024 = '2024-11-01' end_2024 = '2024-11-30' col_2024 = viirs_fires.filterBounds(punjab_haryana).filterDate(start_2024, end_2024) count_2024 = col_2024.size().getInfo() print(f"Nov 2024: {count_2024} fire detections") print() # Validation checks if count_2024 is None or count_2024 == 0: if count_2024 == 0: print("No VIIRS fire detections in Nov 2024 - checking data availability...") # Check if any historical data exists if not fire_counts or all(v == 0 for v in fire_counts.values()): print("C1") else: print("Nov 2024 has 0 fires detected.") print("C2") else: print("C3") else: # Compare Nov 2024 with all historical Novembers historical_counts = [v for v in fire_counts.values() if v > 0] if not historical_counts: print("No valid historical data for comparison.") print("C1") else: min_historical = min(fire_counts.values()) max_historical = max(fire_counts.values()) avg_historical = sum(fire_counts.values()) / len(fire_counts) print(f"Historical Nov Fire Counts (2012-2023):") print(f" Min: {min_historical}, Max: {max_historical}, Avg: {avg_historical:.1f}") print(f"Nov 2024 Count: {count_2024}") print() # Check if Nov 2024 is lower than ANY other November is_lower_than_any = count_2024 < max(fire_counts.values()) if count_2024 < min_historical: print("Nov 2024 is LOWEST fire count on record (2012-2024).") print("A") elif is_lower_than_any and count_2024 < avg_historical: print("Nov 2024 fires are lower than most historical Novembers.") print("A") else: print("Nov 2024 fires are not lower than historical pattern.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate bounding box)
punjab_haryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.0, 78.5, 32.5])

# VIIRS Fire data collection
viirs_fires = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS')

print("Analyzing VIIRS fire counts for November (2012-2023 vs 2024)...")
print("Region: Punjab & Haryana")
print()

# Collect fire counts for each November
fire_counts = {}

# Historical Novembers (2012-2023)
for year in range(2012, 2024):
    start_date = f'{year}-11-01'
    end_date = f'{year}-11-30'
    
    col = viirs_fires.filterBounds(punjab_haryana).filterDate(start_date, end_date)
    count = col.size().getInfo()
    
    if count > 0:
        # Sum confidence detections
        fire_counts[year] = count
        print(f"Nov {year}: {count} fire detections")
    else:
        print(f"Nov {year}: 0 detections")

# November 2024
start_2024 = '2024-11-01'
end_2024 = '2024-11-30'

col_2024 = viirs_fires.filterBounds(punjab_haryana).filterDate(start_2024, end_2024)
count_2024 = col_2024.size().getInfo()

print(f"Nov 2024: {count_2024} fire detections")
print()

# Validation checks
if count_2024 is None or count_2024 == 0:
    if count_2024 == 0:
        print("No VIIRS fire detections in Nov 2024 - checking data availability...")
        # Check if any historical data exists
        if not fire_counts or all(v == 0 for v in fire_counts.values()):
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        else:
            print("Nov 2024 has 0 fires detected.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # Compare Nov 2024 with all historical Novembers
    historical_counts = [v for v in fire_counts.values() if v > 0]
    
    if not historical_counts:
        print("No valid historical data for comparison.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        min_historical = min(fire_counts.values())
        max_historical = max(fire_counts.values())
        avg_historical = sum(fire_counts.values()) / len(fire_counts)
        
        print(f"Historical Nov Fire Counts (2012-2023):")
        print(f"  Min: {min_historical}, Max: {max_historical}, Avg: {avg_historical:.1f}")
        print(f"Nov 2024 Count: {count_2024}")
        print()
        
        # Check if Nov 2024 is lower than ANY other November
        is_lower_than_any = count_2024 < max(fire_counts.values())
        
        if count_2024 < min_historical:
            print("Nov 2024 is LOWEST fire count on record (2012-2024).")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        elif is_lower_than_any and count_2024 < avg_historical:
            print("Nov 2024 fires are lower than most historical Novembers.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Nov 2024 fires are not lower than historical pattern.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
